title_o: Feeling the future: Experimental evidence for anomalous retroactive influences on cognition and affect.

replications.quote: It is clear that the evidence in favor of H0 increases as more participants are tested and the number of sessions increases. With the default prior, the data are 16.6 times more likely under H0 than under H1; with the “knowledge-based prior” from Bem, Utts, and Johnson (2011), the data are 6.2 times more likely under H0 than under H1
